title: Patient_3_4_Day_1_3_7_MixA
treatment_protocol_ch1: Patients were treated with BAF312 or placebo control
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMC were isolated and cryopreserved. PBMC were thawed in batches, with all timepoints for a given patient thawed and analyzed at once. Five total batches: Patient 2, Patients 3 & 4, Patient 5, Patient 6, Patients 7 & 8. Cells were then stained with fluorescently-labeled antibodies specific for canonical cell lineage markers, fixable Live/Dead stain, and in some cases hashing antibodies. Live cells were isolated via FACS Aria before analysis by 10X.
Library construction was performed according to manufacturer's protocol using 10X genomics single cell 3' v3 chemistry.
data_processing: Reads were aligned using CellRanger v7.1.0, using the human reference transcriptome GRCh38-2020-A.
Assembly: Human GRCh38-2020-A
Supplementary files format and content: Feature Barcode Market Exchange Matrices (MEX) produced by CellRanger v7.1.0
